chunks: It is narrated from Masʿadah ibn Ziyād, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Women are of four categories: among them is a fertile spring; among them is one who is gathering and abundant; among them is a burden that is subduing; and among them is a shackle infested with lice.

key_terms.جَامِعٌ: one who gathers or possesses abundance
key_terms.رَبِيعٌ: a fertile spring-like type, suggesting freshness and benefit

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about women being of four types mean?
ai.summary: This hadith classifies women into four figurative types, using concise and vivid Arabic expressions. It is a moral and social observation about differing dispositions and their effects within family life.
